beats.label: S1 · Piper arrives
beats.text: Piper Chapman leaves fiancé Larry to serve 15 months at Litchfield, where she discovers her ex-girlfriend and drug-cartel recruiter Alex Vause is also inside.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the entire love triangle and the reason for Piper's imprisonment.

beats.label: S1 · Red's kitchen
beats.text: Piper insults kitchen matriarch Red and is starved out until she engineers a medicated peace offering that earns Red's grudging protection.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Red's power and the prison's kitchen politics that continue for years.

beats.label: S1 · Mendez and Tricia
beats.text: CO Mendez pressures Red into smuggling drugs; when she refuses, he sells them himself, and inmate Tricia overdoses. Mendez stages her death as a suicide.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Mendez on a collision course with Bennett and Caputo, and fractures Red's operation.

beats.label: S1 · The affair
beats.text: Piper and Alex rekindle their affair; Healy discovers it and throws Piper in SHU, then tips Larry, who breaks off the engagement in visitation.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends the Larry engagement and cements Piper's split loyalty between two worlds.

beats.label: S1 · Daya's scheme
beats.text: Daya sleeps with CO Bennett — her real love — and separately stages sex with Mendez so he can be blamed when her pregnancy surfaces.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Creates the pregnancy that will drive Daya, Bennett, Aleida, and Mendez's storylines for seasons.

beats.label: S1 · Red falls
beats.text: Bennett reports Red's Neptune's Produce smuggling to Caputo; Red loses her kitchen to Gloria, and Mendez is arrested for statutory rape once Daya's pregnancy shows.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Strips Red of her power base, setting up her season-two struggle to rebuild.

beats.label: S1 · The attack
beats.text: On Christmas Eve, Pennsatucky comes for Piper with a shiv over the SHU 'lesbianing'; Healy sees them, walks off, and Piper beats her senseless in the snow.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The fight, and Healy's abandonment, is the cliffhanger and reshapes both women.

cliffhanger.text: Piper is beating Pennsatucky unconscious in the snowy prison yard while Healy deliberately walks away. Larry has left her, Alex has cut her out, and the outcome of the fight is unknown.
questions: Is Pennsatucky alive, and what will happen to Piper?
How will Healy answer for turning his back?
Where does Piper stand with Alex now that Larry is gone?

characters.name: Piper Chapman
characters.line: New inmate serving 15 months; has just savagely beaten Pennsatucky in the yard.

characters.name: Alex Vause
characters.line: Piper's ex and the drug-cartel recruiter who named her; has cut Piper out after Piper chose Larry.

characters.name: Larry Bloom
characters.line: Piper's ex-fiancé, who ended the engagement after learning of the Alex affair.

characters.name: Red (Galina Reznikov)
characters.line: Deposed kitchen matriarch, severed from her Russian smuggling network and outmatched by Gloria.

characters.name: Sam Healy
characters.line: Homophobic counselor who mentored Piper, then walked off as she was attacked.

characters.name: Pennsatucky (Tiffany Doggett)
characters.line: Meth-country zealot radicalised by anti-abortion activists who declared her a hero for shooting a doctor.

characters.name: Suzanne 'Crazy Eyes' Warren
characters.line: Volatile inmate, once infatuated with Piper and easily manipulated by anyone offering approval.

characters.name: Daya Diaz
characters.line: Pregnant by CO Bennett; has framed CO Mendez as the father via a staged assignation.

characters.name: John Bennett
characters.line: Prosthetic-legged CO secretly in love with Daya and terrified of exposure.

characters.name: Nicky Nichols
characters.line: Red's recovering-addict lieutenant; briefly slept with Alex after Piper chose Larry.

beats.label: S2 · Chicago perjury
beats.text: Piper is flown to Chicago to testify against Alex's cartel boss Kubra; Alex begs her to lie, then tells the truth herself, leaving Piper facing perjury charges.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Alex's release and re-poisons the trust between her and Piper for seasons.

beats.label: S2 · Vee returns
beats.text: Vee arrives at Litchfield — Taystee's manipulative surrogate mother from her drug-dealing past, and Red's old rival who once had her beaten nearly to death.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the season's central antagonist and rewrites the Black-inmate power structure.

beats.label: S2 · Rival smuggling
beats.text: Red rebuilds through a hidden greenhouse tunnel; Vee builds a rival black-market operation through the Black inmates, recruiting Suzanne as muscle.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the season's parallel smuggling networks that will collide.

beats.label: S2 · Vee takes over
beats.text: Vee muscles into Red's tunnel and starts selling heroin; Poussey refuses to work for her, and their opposition tears her friendship with Taystee apart.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Poussey-Taystee split is the emotional spine of the black-inmate arc.

beats.label: S2 · Furlough & fallout
beats.text: Furlough for Piper's grandmother's funeral reveals Larry slept with her best friend Polly; back inside, Bennett confesses Daya's pregnancy to Caputo, who buries it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes the Larry chapter for Piper and puts Daya's paternity secret in Caputo's hands.

beats.label: S2 · Fig exposed
beats.text: Piper feeds Caputo evidence that Deputy Warden Fig has been embezzling; Fig is forced to resign, and Caputo takes over Litchfield.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Caputo in charge — the administrative axis for everything that follows.

beats.label: S2 · Rosa runs Vee down
beats.text: Vee slocks Red after a fake truce and escapes through the tunnel; terminal inmate Rosa steals the prison van, spots Vee by the road, and runs her down.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Kills the season's antagonist and empties the top of the smuggling food chain.

cliffhanger.text: Rosa has just killed Vee with the stolen prison van and vanished. Red is recovering in medical, Suzanne has been exonerated, and both major smuggling networks that ran Litchfield have collapsed.
questions: Will Rosa be caught, and how long does her cancer give her?
Who fills the vacuum left by Vee and Red's ruined operations?
Will Piper face perjury charges for lying at Kubra's trial?

characters.name: Piper Chapman
characters.line: Facing perjury charges after lying at Kubra's trial; back at Litchfield with Larry now dating her best friend.

characters.name: Alex Vause
characters.line: Released for testifying against Kubra; paranoid on the outside that he will retaliate.

characters.name: Red
characters.line: Recovering after Vee slocked her; her outside deli has closed and her Litchfield family is fragmented.

characters.name: Vee Parker
characters.line: Dead — Rosa ran her down after she took over the Black inmates and nearly killed Red.

characters.name: Taystee
characters.line: Manipulated back into Vee's fold and then abandoned; grieving Vee as the mother she never had.

characters.name: Poussey Washington
characters.line: Sober and in a shaky reconciliation with Taystee after standing against Vee alone.

characters.name: Suzanne 'Crazy Eyes' Warren
characters.line: Used by Vee, framed for the attack on Red, then exonerated when the guards turned on Vee.

characters.name: Caputo
characters.line: Ousted Fig and now runs Litchfield; quietly sitting on Bennett's confession about Daya.

characters.name: Daya Diaz
characters.line: Pregnancy public; Mendez arrested as presumed father while Bennett is the real one.

characters.name: Nicky Nichols
characters.line: Red's loyal lieutenant; helped plot against Vee and remains a core member of Red's family.

beats.label: S3 · MCC takeover
beats.text: Alex is dragged back to Litchfield after Piper tips her parole officer; MCC buys the prison to save it from closure and immediately guts food and staffing.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Both facts — Alex's return and the corporate takeover — set the frame for every remaining season.

beats.label: S3 · Nicky to max
beats.text: Nicky's hidden heroin stash is found; Luschek turns her in to save himself, and she is shipped to maximum security, gutting Red's family.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes Red's daughter figure and marks the moment the family starts fracturing.

beats.label: S3 · Bennett walks out
beats.text: Bennett meets Daya's chaotic family, sees Cesar with a gun near a baby, and simply drives off — abandoning Daya and their unborn child.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes Bennett from the show and reshapes Daya's future.

beats.label: S3 · Panty business
beats.text: Piper starts a used-panty smuggling operation from her Whispers factory job, recruiting Alex, Flaca, Cal, and new inmate Stella into the scheme.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Piper's corruption arc; introduces Stella and sets up Piper's clash with Maria.

beats.label: S3 · Coates rapes Doggett
beats.text: New CO Coates courts and then rapes Pennsatucky in the prison van; Big Boo learns and pushes her toward revenge before they both back out.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Defines Pennsatucky and Coates for the seasons that follow.

beats.label: S3 · Kubra hunts Alex
beats.text: Kubra is acquitted and Alex becomes convinced he has sent an assassin for her; she fixates on paranoid new inmate Lolly as the likely killer.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Aydin thread that opens the next season begins here.

beats.label: S3 · Fence breaks
beats.text: Piper frames Stella for theft to send her to max; a fence collapse lets the inmates walk out to a nearby lake as busloads of new prisoners arrive at Litchfield.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up next season's overcrowding and Alex's greenhouse ambush.

cliffhanger.text: The inmates are frolicking briefly free in a lake outside the walls. Buses of new prisoners are pulling into Litchfield, and a stranger — Kubra's assassin — has just cornered Alex alone in the greenhouse.
questions: Does Alex survive the attack in the greenhouse?
How will overcrowded Litchfield function once the buses unload?
Will Coates ever face consequences for what he did to Pennsatucky?

characters.name: Piper Chapman
characters.line: Hardened and corrupted by her successful panty business; alienated Alex after framing Stella for theft.

characters.name: Alex Vause
characters.line: Ratted out by Piper and back inside; convinced Kubra has just sent someone to kill her.

characters.name: Red
characters.line: Bullied her way back into the kitchen only to be reduced to serving MCC's boil-in-bag pouches.

characters.name: Nicky Nichols
characters.line: Sent to maximum security after Luschek turned her in over the heroin stash.

characters.name: Caputo
characters.line: Newly promoted under MCC; increasingly disgusted by corporate cost-cutting.

characters.name: Suzanne 'Crazy Eyes' Warren
characters.line: Author of a wildly popular erotic sci-fi serial passed around the prison.

characters.name: Poussey Washington
characters.line: In a fragile new relationship with Soso, who nearly overdosed on Healy's prescription.

characters.name: Pennsatucky (Doggett)
characters.line: Raped by CO Coates in the prison van; contemplated revenge and backed away.

characters.name: Charlie Coates
characters.line: The rapist CO, who has since apologised and remains on staff at Litchfield.

characters.name: Daya Diaz
characters.line: Agreed to let Mendez's mother raise her baby after Bennett abandoned her, but Aleida sabotaged the arrangement.

characters.name: Judy King
characters.line: Celebrity chef arraigned on tax-evasion charges and found guilty, though not sent to Litchfield.

characters.name: Lolly
characters.line: Paranoid new inmate whom Alex is convinced is Kubra's hired killer.

beats.label: S4 · Alex kills Aydin
beats.text: Alex is attacked in the greenhouse by Kubra's man Aydin; Lolly beats him unconscious and Alex smothers him. Frieda helps them cut up and bury the body in the garden.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The body drives the season's investigation, Lolly's breakdown, and Healy's collapse.

beats.label: S4 · Piscatella arrives
beats.text: MCC doubles the population and hires untrained veteran COs housed in cabins; new head guard Piscatella imposes a brutal, humiliating regime.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the season's institutional antagonist and the conditions that produce the riot.

beats.label: S4 · Judy's privilege
beats.text: Celebrity Judy King is given a private room and a cooking class while Sophia rots in solitary, sparking Black-inmate outrage and racial tensions across the yard.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Frames the moral rot the inmates will eventually revolt against.

beats.label: S4 · The swastika
beats.text: Piper's feud with Maria's Dominican panty operation curdles into an all-white 'security' group; Maria retaliates by branding a swastika into Piper's arm.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Breaks Piper's arc of arrogance and locks Maria into the season's spiral.

beats.label: S4 · Body uncovered
beats.text: Groundsmen find Aydin's body; Piscatella interrogates the inmates by force. Healy realises Lolly's confession was real, hands her in, and commits himself to a mental hospital.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes Healy from Litchfield and lights Piscatella's fuse.

beats.label: S4 · Poussey dies
beats.text: A peaceful table-standing protest against Piscatella escalates; Suzanne panics, Poussey rushes to help her, and rookie CO Bayley suffocates Poussey while restraining her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The death that becomes the show's political and moral centre for years.

beats.label: S4 · Riot ignites
beats.text: MCC stalls calling police to spin the story; Caputo on camera refuses to fire Bayley. Taystee marches the halls, Humphrey draws his gun, and Daya picks it up.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The cliffhanger and the trigger for the season-five riot.

cliffhanger.text: Daya is standing over CO Humphrey with his own drawn gun as inmates around her scream for her to shoot. Poussey lies dead in the cafeteria, Caputo has publicly refused MCC's order to fire Bayley, and the prison is one squeeze from full revolt.
questions: Does Daya pull the trigger?
Will MCC, the state, or Bayley be held accountable for Poussey's death?
Has Caputo destroyed his own career defending the truth?

characters.name: Piper Chapman
characters.line: Humbled after the branding; the swastika altered into a window by Red, and back in the family alongside Alex and Nicky.

characters.name: Alex Vause
characters.line: Confessed the Aydin killing to Piper's circle; back close to Piper again.

characters.name: Red
characters.line: Matriarch again with her family reunited around her as chaos builds.

characters.name: Nicky Nichols
characters.line: Returned from max but relapsed on heroin; getting clean again with Pennsatucky's help.

characters.name: Taystee
characters.line: Grieving Poussey and now the inmates' de-facto leader, marching them into the standoff.

characters.name: Poussey Washington
characters.line: Killed by CO Bayley during the protest — the emotional core of the coming uprising.

characters.name: Suzanne 'Crazy Eyes' Warren
characters.line: Off her meds after a savage fight with Maureen; her panic pulled Poussey into the fatal moment.

characters.name: Caputo
characters.line: Publicly refused MCC's order to fire Bayley; his authority hanging by a thread.

characters.name: Piscatella
characters.line: Brutal head guard whose refusal to back down produced the standoff.

characters.name: Daya Diaz
characters.line: Holding a loaded gun on CO Humphrey with the inmates urging her to fire.

characters.name: Bayley
characters.line: Rookie CO who killed Poussey; distraught and about to be scapegoated by MCC.

beats.label: S5 · The riot ignites
beats.text: Daya shoots CO Humphrey in the thigh, the guards are stripped and held hostage across the chapel, and the inmates take control of Litchfield.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The riot is the entire season's setting.

beats.label: S5 · Caputo on camera
beats.text: Taystee forces Caputo on camera to read a statement about Poussey's death; the video is mocked online, humiliating MCC and drawing the governor into the crisis.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Taystee as the negotiator and pulls the state into the standoff.

beats.label: S5 · Demands and talks
beats.text: The inmates draft demands — GED, healthcare, amnesty, Bayley's prosecution; Taystee grows into a natural negotiator opposite a returning Fig as MCC mediator.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Frames the negotiation Taystee is leading and reintroduces Fig as adversary.

beats.label: S5 · Frieda's bunker
beats.text: Frieda reveals a Cold War-style bunker she stocked inside an unused pool; Red uncovers Piscatella's history of murdering a male inmate and lures him toward Litchfield.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The bunker and Piscatella's past are the machinery for the finale.

beats.label: S5 · Piscatella's night raid
beats.text: Piscatella breaks into the prison in full riot gear at night, kidnapping and torturing Red, Alex, and others until the bunker inmates rescue them and tie him up alive.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Turns Piscatella from villain into hostage and physically breaks Alex.

beats.label: S5 · Maria breaks ranks
beats.text: Desperate for a deal that shortens her sentence, Maria releases the guard hostages through the fence behind Taystee's back; MCC calls in the CERT to end the riot by force.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Kills the negotiation and forces the finale confrontation.

beats.label: S5 · CERT breach
beats.text: CERT storm the prison; ten inmates hide in Frieda's bunker linking arms as the doors blow. Red releases Piscatella alive and a rookie CERT officer immediately shoots him dead.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The final image and the setup for the max-security fallout.

cliffhanger.text: CERT officers have blown the bunker door as ten inmates — Piper, Alex, Red, Taystee, Nicky, Suzanne, Cindy, Blanca, Gloria, and Frieda — link arms inside. Piscatella lies dead in the hallway. Everyone else has been loaded onto buses to unknown prisons overnight.
questions: Where will the bunker ten be sent, and will they be separated?
Who ends up charged for the riot and for Piscatella's death?
Where has the rest of Litchfield's population been scattered?

characters.name: Taystee
characters.line: The public face of the riot; grew into a passionate negotiator demanding justice for Poussey.

characters.name: Piper Chapman
characters.line: Prison-married Alex during the riot; hiding in the bunker as CERT breaks in.

characters.name: Alex Vause
characters.line: Arm broken by Piscatella; married to Piper and hiding in the bunker beside her.

characters.name: Red
characters.line: Came off amphetamines, led the plot against Piscatella, and released him alive at the end.

characters.name: Nicky Nichols
characters.line: Kicked drugs again mid-riot; helped rescue the tortured inmates and is with the bunker group.

characters.name: Suzanne 'Crazy Eyes' Warren
characters.line: Deteriorated further off her meds; still with the bunker ten.

characters.name: Frieda
characters.line: Reclusive old-timer whose Cold War bunker in an unused pool just saved everyone.

characters.name: Daya Diaz
characters.line: Shot Humphrey to start the riot; the hostages are freed and she is now a killer facing charges.

characters.name: Caputo
characters.line: Slept with MCC's Linda, then quit after the negotiations collapsed.

characters.name: Piscatella
characters.line: Dead — shot by a CERT rookie after Red released him from the bunker.

characters.name: Maria
characters.line: Released the hostages behind Taystee's back to broker her own release deal.

beats.label: S6 · Litchfield Max
beats.text: The bunker ten are dumped into Litchfield's max-security wing under abuse from guards and inmates; federal investigators demand two murderers and three riot leaders within the week.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the season's new setting and the pressure that forces the wrongful charges.

beats.label: S6 · Charges laid
beats.text: Daya pleads guilty for Humphrey's murder; MCC pins Piscatella's death on Taystee, and Gloria testifies against Maria to save her own release date.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The wrongful murder charge is the season's central injustice.

beats.label: S6 · The block feud
beats.text: The bunker inmates are dropped into gen pop and straight into a decades-old feud between rival sister-gang leaders Barbara in D Block and Carol in C Block.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Frames the new prison hierarchy and Red's, Nicky's, and Piper's alliances.

beats.label: S6 · Alex and McCullough
beats.text: Piper spends weeks fearing Alex died in the pool; Alex resurfaces in gen pop, coerced into CO Hellman's drug trade, and begins a secret affair with CO McCullough.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reunites Piper and Alex, and starts the affair that reshapes both women.

beats.label: S6 · Cindy's betrayal
beats.text: Cindy, told her story is 'unreliable' unless it matches the prosecution, testifies against Taystee at trial. The jury finds Taystee guilty of murdering Piscatella.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The betrayal defines Taystee and Cindy's arcs from here on.

beats.label: S6 · Piper released
beats.text: CO Hopper moves Piper to the top of a new release-ranking system; she and Sophia walk out under a settlement, and Blanca — promised freedom — is seized by ICE at the gate.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes Piper from the prison setting and opens the ICE-detention thread.

beats.label: S6 · Sisters die
beats.text: Barbara and Carol meet during a staged kickball-day war and kill each other, ending the feud.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends the season's power structure and installs Daya as the new kingpin.

cliffhanger.text: Piper is out and struggling to adjust; Alex is stuck inside for years. Taystee has been convicted for a murder she didn't commit. Blanca, promised release, was seized at the gate by ICE.
questions: How will Piper and Alex sustain a marriage across the prison wall?
Can Taystee ever expose the truth about Piscatella's death and clear her name?
Will Blanca get out of ICE detention and see Diablo again?

characters.name: Piper Chapman
characters.line: Released early after Hopper moved her up the ranking system; married to Alex and out in New York.

characters.name: Alex Vause
characters.line: Still incarcerated with years left; pulled into Badison and Luschek's smartphone smuggling and now working for Carol to keep Badison in line.

characters.name: Taystee
characters.line: Wrongly convicted of murdering Piscatella; utterly betrayed by Cindy's testimony.

characters.name: Cindy
characters.line: Betrayed Taystee on the stand to save herself; wracked with guilt as she prepares for release.

characters.name: Red
characters.line: Feuded with Frieda after learning she once betrayed Carol; showing the first cracks of forgetfulness.

characters.name: Nicky Nichols
characters.line: In minimum security after the trial; bonded with Barbara over addiction before Barbara's death.

characters.name: Daya Diaz
characters.line: Serving life for Humphrey's murder; strung out on Daddy's supply and sinking deeper into addiction.

characters.name: Aleida
characters.line: Struggling outside; now living with CO Hopper and his household.

characters.name: Blanca
characters.line: Won her release, then was seized at the gate by ICE agents.

characters.name: Lorna
characters.line: Goes into labor and is brought to medical in distress.

characters.name: Carol Denning
characters.line: Dead — killed alongside her sister Barbara during the finale block war.

characters.name: Barbara Denning
characters.line: Dead — killed with Carol; her death ends the decades-old sister feud.

beats.label: S7 · Life after Litchfield
beats.text: Piper flails outside — parole fees, minimum-wage retail, a distant father — while Alex is trapped in CO Hellman's drug trade and CO McCullough's grip in prison.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The marriage-across-the-wall thread that carries the season.

beats.label: S7 · Warden Tamika
beats.text: CO Tamika Ward — Taystee's childhood friend — is promoted to warden and launches education programs, closes the SHU, and tries to revive Litchfield from within.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the season's reformist force and Taystee's inside ally.

beats.label: S7 · Daya the kingpin
beats.text: Daya kills Daddy with a fentanyl overdose after Daddy's infidelity, takes over the block's drugs, and coerces the new GED teacher into becoming her mule.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Daya's descent poisons the reform program and drives Pennsatucky's death.

beats.label: S7 · Taystee bottoms out
beats.text: Taystee's appeal collapses; she hoards Daya's fentanyl planning suicide. Red slides visibly into early-onset dementia despite Nicky's efforts to protect her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Two of the season's emotional through-lines converging.

beats.label: S7 · ICE detention
beats.text: PolyCon's new ICE facility swallows Blanca, Maritza, and Karla; Maritza is deported to Colombia, and Blanca uses the online law library to buy herself more time.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The ICE plot is one of the season's two major new arenas.

beats.label: S7 · Lorna breaks
beats.text: Lorna's baby Sterling dies of pneumonia; she refuses to accept it, insists he is alive, and finally triggers a lockdown trying to walk out of the prison to find him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends Lorna's arc and sends her to the psychiatric Florida block.

beats.label: S7 · Pennsatucky dies
beats.text: Pennsatucky, denied dyslexia accommodations by Luschek on the GED, believes she failed and snorts Daya's fentanyl. She overdoses and dies — after passing the exam.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's climactic death and Daya's moral bottom.

cliffhanger.text: The series closes on scattered endings. Alex is transferred to an Ohio prison and Piper moves there to be near her. Taystee, serving life, launches the Poussey Washington Fund with Judy King's help. Blanca reunites with Diablo in Honduras. Tamika is fired; Hellman replaces her as warden.
questions: Can Alex and Piper sustain their marriage across years and a prison wall?
Will Taystee's Poussey Washington Fund grow into real reform beyond her cell?
Can any of the deported women — Karla, Maritza — ever get back into the country?

characters.name: Piper Chapman
characters.line: Moved to Ohio to be near Alex's new prison after months of scraping by in New York.

characters.name: Alex Vause
characters.line: Transferred out of Litchfield by a spiteful McCullough to an Ohio prison filled with former Litchfield faces.

characters.name: Taystee
characters.line: Serving life for a murder she didn't commit; launched the Poussey Washington Fund with Judy King's help.

characters.name: Daya Diaz
characters.line: The prison's drug kingpin whose fentanyl killed Pennsatucky; estranged from Aleida, who chokes her after discovering she brought her younger siblings into the drug operation.

characters.name: Aleida
characters.line: Back inside after assaulting her daughter's dealer; horrified at what Daya has become.

characters.name: Red
characters.line: Deep in early-onset dementia and transferred to the Florida block; no longer recognises Frieda.

characters.name: Nicky Nichols
characters.line: Became a mother figure to a new generation of Litchfield inmates; heartbroken over Red and Lorna.

characters.name: Lorna
characters.line: Broken by Sterling's death; abandoned by Vince and now in the psychiatric Florida block.

characters.name: Blanca
characters.line: Won her ICE case at the last moment and reunited with Diablo in Honduras.

characters.name: Tamika Ward
characters.line: Fired as warden after Hellman's drugs turned up outside the prison; replaced by Hellman himself.

characters.name: Pennsatucky (Doggett)
characters.line: Dead — overdosed on Daya's fentanyl believing she had failed the GED she had actually passed.
